title: Beyond Cross-Lingual Transfer: Benchmarking Propagation Boundaries in Multilingual LLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2609.05976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning aims to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities. In multilingual settings, unlearning must additionally propagate within its intended linguistic scope. However, existing evaluations mainly measure cross-lingual transfer and cannot distinguish insufficient from excessive propagation. We introduce CLLPU (Cross-Lingual and Language-Bound Protocol for LLM Unlearning), a multilingual benchmark that formulates this problem through two settings: common-goal forgetting, where target knowledge should be suppressed across all languages, and language-conditioned forgetting, where suppression should remain confined to a designated language. CLLPU combines goal-guided topic pairing, schema-aware relation matching, and dual-anchor multilingual translation to construct 800 matched knowledge-unit pairs and 72,000 QA instances across ten languages. Experiments with six representative methods

translated_title: 超越跨语言迁移：多语言大模型遗忘中传播边界的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）遗忘旨在抑制目标知识的同时保留通用能力。在多语言环境中，遗忘还必须在预期的语言范围内进行传播。然而，现有的评估主要衡量跨语言迁移，无法区分传播不足与传播过度。我们提出了CLLPU（LLM遗忘的跨语言与语言边界协议），这是一个多语言基准，通过两种设置来阐述这一问题：共同目标遗忘，即目标知识应在所有语言中被抑制；以及语言条件遗忘，即抑制应仅限于指定语言内。CLLPU结合了目标引导的主题配对、模式感知的关系匹配和双锚点多语言翻译方法，构建了涵盖十种语言的800个匹配知识单元对和72,000个问答实例。使用六种代表性方法进行的实验……
tldr: 本文提出了CLLPU多语言基准，通过共同目标遗忘和语言条件遗忘两种设置，首次系统评估大语言模型遗忘中知识抑制在语言间传播不足与传播过度的边界问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CLLPU, a multilingual benchmark that evaluates propagation boundaries in LLM unlearning by distinguishing insufficient from excessive cross-lingual knowledge suppression through common-goal and language-conditioned forgetting settings.
